title: Energy, intensity and amplitude
design_rationale: Quantify energy transfer only after amplitude and wave motion are secure.
concepts_taught: Use intensity as power transferred per unit area.
Distinguish source power from intensity at a location.
Use intensity proportional to amplitude squared.
Compare amplitudes from intensity ratios and graphical data.
